verdict.rationale: Grouping chats and files into a project or space with shared context and instructions is a fair axis for a consumer AI assistant like Copilot, so it applies. The evidence pack shows only global memory of user-requested facts (copilot-docs-32), file search through connectors and deletion of conversation history. None of these is a project, space or notebook that groups chats and files under shared instructions, so there is no evidence the capability exists.
